table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	purorderheader.ManfCode,   
	AliasName = dbo.Accounts.AliasName,
	purorderheader.SuppCode,   
	purorderheader.Date,   
	purorderheader.POCode,
	dbo.purorderheader.salesmancode,
	dbo.purorderheader.remarks,  
	dbo.purorderheader.remarks2,  
	dbo.purorderheader.remarks3,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms1,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms2,
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms3,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms4,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms5,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms6,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms7,  
	dbo.purorderheader.purorderterms8,  
	dbo.users.username,     
	dbo.purorderheader.projectionperiod,
	dbo.purorderheader.ZeroQty,
	dbo.purorderheader.demanddraftno,
	dbo.purorderheader.dated,
	dbo.purorderheader.amount,
	dbo.purorderheader.custcode,
	dbo.purorderheader.startdate,
	dbo.purorderheader.EndDate,
	dbo.purorderheader.discperc,
	dbo.purorderheader.posted,
	dbo.purorderheader.PurOrderCatCode,
	dbo.purorderheader.SaleOrderCode,
	dbo.purorderheader.PurQuotationCode,
	dbo.purorderheader.SupplierReference,
	dbo.purorderheader.DeliveryLocation,
	dbo.purorderheader.UsageLocation,
	dbo.purorderheader.RequiredDate,
	dbo.purorderheader.InvGSTPerc1,
	dbo.purorderheader.FlatDisc,
	dbo.purorderheader.MiscCharges,
	dbo.purorderheader.CurrencyCode,
	dbo.purorderheader.ConversionFactor,
	dbo.purorderheader.icatcode,
	dbo.purorderheader.purtypecode,
	dbo.purorderheader.sitecode,
	dbo.purorderheader.targetsitecode
FROM 
	purorderheader,   
	Accounts,
	users  
WHERE 
	dbo.purorderheader.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND  
	dbo.purorderheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode AND  
	dbo.purorderheader.pocode = :ra_pocode
